name: FlashData — Google Search & YouTube Data/Download API
description: Managed Google Search (Web, News, Images, Shopping, Videos, Places), YouTube Data (search, metadata, timestamped transcripts/captions, channels), and cloud YouTube video/audio downloads (S3, GCS, Azure, R2) in one hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server (22 tools). Start with a free trial (no credit card required); pay-as-you-go from $0.40/1k Search, $0.20/1k YouTube Data, $0.04/GB Download. Endpoint: `https://data.flashdata.dev/mcp` · Install: `npx -y @flashdata-dev/mcp` · [Docs](https://flashdata.dev/docs)
